tools.description:
Execute an action and return before/after/diff screenshots with change percentage.
Actions: "click" (needs selector), "type" (needs selector + text), "navigate" (needs url).
Params is a JSON string, e.g. {"selector": "@1"}, {"selector": "coord:100,200"}, or {"url": "https://example.com"}.
tools.name: action_diff

tools.description:
Analyze a JavaScript bundle using coverage data to infer its original source structure.

If the MCP client supports sampling, the analysis happens automatically via CreateMessage.
Otherwise, returns extracted code chunks for you to analyze manually, then call
set_bundle_structure with the inferred file structure.
tools.name: analyze_bundle

tools.description: Analyze a Chrome trace JSON file and return Core Web Vitals: LCP, INP, and CLS. Use path "-" to read from stdin.
tools.name: analyze_trace

tools.description: Click, type, or navigate using a browser_observe state_id and target_id. Click/type require an @ref; navigate requires an absolute url and targets the observed frame. Consumes that state before attempting the action; stale nodes are never recovered by name. Returns independent execution, observation and postcondition results and, when captured, a fresh_state. expect compares exact textContent of one CSS match immediately after capture. Never automatically replay an uncertain action. Timeout is milliseconds, default 30000, maximum 60000.
tools.name: browser_act

tools.description: Observe the active browser target. Returns a state_id, exact target/document identity, and a tree with @refs. Replaces the previous observation. Use browser_act with this state_id and target_id. Optional frame_id selects an exact frame in this target; otherwise uses the selected frame or root.
tools.name: browser_observe

tools.description: Check element state (visible, enabled, checked, selected, focused) by CSS selector or @ref
tools.name: check_element

tools.description: Clear all data in extension storage area via Runtime.evaluate in the extension's service worker. Area: local (default), sync, session, or managed.
tools.name: clear_extension_storage

tools.description: Clear localStorage or sessionStorage. Type must be "local" or "session". If key is provided, removes only that key; otherwise clears all.
tools.name: clear_storage

tools.description: Click an element by CSS selector, @ref (e.g. @1 from page_snapshot), or viewport coordinates as coord:x,y. Timeout in seconds (default 30).
tools.name: click

tools.description: Close a browser tab by target ID. If no ID given, closes the current tab.
tools.name: close_tab

tools.description: Compare two named coverage snapshots with per-file, per-function, and line-range detail
tools.name: compare_coverage

tools.description: Connect to a different CDP endpoint. Tears down current browser context and connects to the new target. Use this to switch between browsers (e.g. Brave on 9222 to Electron on 9223).
tools.name: connect

tools.description: Compare two named DOM snapshots and show a git-style diff of what changed. Use snapshot_dom to capture before/after states.
tools.name: dom_diff

tools.description: Drag from one element to another. Source and target are CSS selectors or @ref. Steps controls intermediate mouse move events (default 10). Timeout in seconds (default 30).
tools.name: drag

tools.description:
Enable the WebMCP domain to discover page-registered MCP tools.

Once enabled, the browser reports toolsAdded/toolsRemoved events as
pages register tools via navigator.modelContext.registerTool().
Use list_web_tools to see discovered tools, invoke_web_tool to call them.
tools.name: enable_webmcp

tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the page context
tools.name: evaluate

tools.description: Get console output and errors from an extension's service worker. Attaches to the service worker target on first call.
tools.name: extension_console

tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the context of an extension's service worker. Finds the service worker target and runs Runtime.evaluate there.
tools.name: extension_evaluate

tools.description: Fill multiple form fields at once. Each field specifies a CSS selector, value, and optional type (text, select, checkbox, radio). Set submit=true to submit the form after filling.
tools.name: fill_form

tools.description: Find interactive elements by role, accessible name, or text content. Returns @ref numbers. Run page_snapshot first to populate refs.
tools.name: find_element

tools.description: Focus an element by CSS selector or @ref. Timeout in seconds (default 30).
tools.name: focus

tools.description: Generate a sourcemap v3 JSON from previously analyzed bundle structure. Returns the raw sourcemap JSON.
tools.name: generate_sourcemap

tools.description: Read the analysis log for a bundle — shows prior reasoning behind sourcemap naming decisions across sessions.
tools.name: get_analysis_log

tools.description: Get captured console messages. Filter by type (log, warn, error, info, debug). Use index (1-based) to get a single message. Returns most recent entries.
tools.name: get_console

tools.description: Get browser cookies, optionally filtered by domain
tools.name: get_cookies

tools.description: Take a coverage snapshot and return per-file summary sorted by coverage (least covered first)
tools.name: get_coverage

tools.description: Get coverage diff between two snapshots showing newly covered lines
tools.name: get_coverage_delta

tools.description: Get the history of JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt) that have appeared, and any currently pending dialog.
tools.name: get_dialogs

tools.description: Get element details (text, value, attributes, bounding box) by CSS selector or @ref
tools.name: get_element

tools.description: Get captured JavaScript exceptions and errors. Returns most recent entries.
tools.name: get_errors

tools.description: Get data from extension storage via Runtime.evaluate in the extension's service worker. Area: local (default), sync, session, or managed. Optionally filter by keys.
tools.name: get_extension_storage

tools.description: Get captured HAR network entries. Filter by domain or url_pattern (substring match). Use index (1-based) to get a single entry. Returns most recent entries when limit is set.
tools.name: get_har_entries

tools.description: Get captured network requests from start_network_log. Optional URL filter (substring match). Set clear=true to reset.
tools.name: get_network_log

tools.description: Get the text or HTML content of the page or a specific element
tools.name: get_page_content

tools.description: Get localStorage or sessionStorage. Type must be "local" or "session". If key is omitted, returns all key-value pairs.
tools.name: get_storage

tools.description: Handle a pending JavaScript dialog (alert, confirm, prompt, beforeunload). Accept or dismiss, optionally providing prompt text.
tools.name: handle_dialog

tools.description: Hover over an element by CSS selector or @ref. Triggers mouseover events. Timeout in seconds (default 30).
tools.name: hover

tools.description: Automated app fingerprinting. Detects: identity (title, URL, Electron/Chrome versions), frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular), bundler (webpack, Vite), non-standard globals, bridge APIs (electronBridge, vscode), feature flags, error monitoring, script inventory, CSP.
tools.name: inspect_fingerprint

tools.description: Get captured IPC messages from inspect_ipc_start. Optional channel filter (substring match). Set clear=true to reset the log after reading.
tools.name: inspect_ipc_log

tools.description: Start capturing Electron IPC messages. Monkey-patches known bridges (electronBridge, vscode, electron) and postMessage listener. Call inspect_ipc_log to read captured messages.
tools.name: inspect_ipc_start

tools.description: Recursively explore a JS object's structure. Returns a typed tree with key counts, function arities, string lengths, and optional sampled values. Handles cycles via WeakSet. Use depth (default 2) and max_keys (default 20) to control output size.
tools.name: inspect_walk

tools.description: Install the bundled coverage DevTools extension at runtime via developerPrivate. Useful when --load-extension was not set at browser launch.
tools.name: install_bundled_extensions

tools.description: Load an unpacked Chrome extension from a local directory path. Tries CDP Extensions.loadUnpacked first, falls back to chrome.developerPrivate.loadUnpacked() on chrome://extensions. Note: JS fallback may trigger a file picker if --enable-unsafe-extension-debugging is not set. Use --load-extension flag at launch for reliable headless loading.
tools.name: install_extension

tools.description: Intercept outgoing requests matching a URL pattern. Actions: "block" (fail the request), "fulfill" (return custom response with status_code, body, content_type), "modify" (change request headers). Pattern supports wildcards (* and ?).
tools.name: intercept_request

tools.description: Intercept responses matching a URL pattern. Actions: "modify" (change response headers/status), "fulfill" (replace response body entirely). Pattern supports wildcards.
tools.name: intercept_response

tools.description:
Invoke a web-page-registered MCP tool by name.

The tool must have been discovered via list_web_tools. Input should be
a JSON string matching the tool's input schema. The invocation happens
via Runtime.evaluate calling navigator.modelContext on the page.
tools.name: invoke_web_tool

tools.description: List all named DOM snapshots available for dom_diff.
tools.name: list_dom_snapshots

tools.description: List installed Chrome extensions. Uses CDP Extensions domain when available, falls back to chrome.developerPrivate.getExtensionsInfo() on chrome://extensions, then target enumeration.
tools.name: list_extensions

tools.description: List all frames (including iframes) in the current page. Returns frame ID, name, URL, and parent.
tools.name: list_frames

tools.description: List all active intercept rules
tools.name: list_intercepts

tools.description: List all coverage snapshots taken during this session
tools.name: list_snapshots

tools.description: List all synthetic sourcemaps and their serving status.
tools.name: list_sourcemaps

tools.description: List all captured JavaScript and CSS sources
tools.name: list_sources

tools.description: List all open browser tabs
tools.name: list_tabs

tools.description:
List MCP tools registered by the current web page via navigator.modelContext.

Requires the WebMCP domain to be enabled (call enable_webmcp first).
Returns tool names, descriptions, input schemas, and annotations.
tools.name: list_web_tools

tools.description: Load browser state (cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage) from a JSON file previously saved with save_state. Optionally navigate to the saved URL.
tools.name: load_state

tools.description: Navigate to a URL
tools.name: navigate

tools.description: Navigate back in browser history
tools.name: navigate_back

tools.description: Navigate forward in browser history
tools.name: navigate_forward

tools.description: Open a new browser tab, optionally navigating to a URL
tools.name: new_tab

tools.description: Get an accessibility tree snapshot of the page. Interactive elements are annotated with @ref numbers (e.g. @1, @2) that can be used with click, type_text, and other interaction tools instead of CSS selectors.
tools.name: page_snapshot

tools.description: Pop the current recording context
tools.name: pop_context

tools.description: Press a keyboard key. Supports: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, Delete, Space, ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right, Home, End, PageUp/PageDown, F1-F12, or any single character. Modifiers: ctrl, alt, shift, meta (comma-separated). Timeout in seconds (default 30).
tools.name: press_key

tools.description: Push a new recording context to isolate traffic
tools.name: push_context

tools.description: Execute a raw Chrome DevTools Protocol method. Defaults to the active target; set target to "browser" for browser-level methods. Example: method Runtime.evaluate with params {"expression":"document.title"}.
tools.name: raw_cdp

tools.description: Read the content of a captured source file by URL
tools.name: read_source

tools.description:
Re-analyze a bundle with additional coverage data (e.g. after more user actions) and update the sourcemap.

If MCP sampling is available, the analysis and update happen automatically.
Otherwise, returns new chunks for you to re-analyze, then call set_bundle_structure.
tools.name: refine_sourcemap

tools.description: Reload the current page
tools.name: reload

tools.description: Reload an unpacked Chrome extension by ID. Uses chrome.developerPrivate.reload() on a temporary chrome://extensions tab.
tools.name: reload_extension

tools.description: Remove an intercept rule by ID, or remove all rules. Use list output from intercept_request/intercept_response to find IDs.
tools.name: remove_intercept

tools.description: Run a cdpscript script through the real cdpscript engine. Provide path or script; script may be txtar or plain .cdp.
tools.name: run_cdpscript

tools.description: Generate a PDF of the current page. Optionally save to a file path. Returns the PDF as base64 if no path given.
tools.name: save_pdf

tools.description: Capture all JS/CSS sources (including sourcemapped originals) from the current page and write to disk
tools.name: save_sources

tools.description: Save browser state (cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, URL) to a JSON file. Provide a path or a name (saved to output dir).
tools.name: save_state

tools.description: Take a screenshot. Options: selector (element only), full_page, width (max px, downscales), quality (1-100, uses JPEG), format (png/jpeg/webp), annotate (draw numbered boxes on interactive elements with metadata).
tools.name: screenshot

tools.description: Scroll the page or an element. Use direction (up/down/left/right) with optional distance in pixels (default 500). Or provide a selector/@ref to scroll that element into view.
tools.name: scroll

tools.description: Search across all captured sources for a text pattern or regex
tools.name: search_source

tools.description: Install a Fetch intercept to serve the synthetic sourcemap for a bundle URL. When Chrome requests the .map file, it gets our generated map instead.
tools.name: serve_sourcemap

tools.description:
Accept inferred source file structure for a bundle and generate a synthetic sourcemap.

Call analyze_bundle first to get the code chunks, then pass your analysis here.
The structure field should be JSON matching: {"files": [...], "summary": "..."}
where each file has: path, description, start_line, end_line, start_offset, end_offset,
functions (optional), framework (optional), module (optional).
tools.name: set_bundle_structure

tools.description: Set a browser cookie
tools.name: set_cookie

tools.description: Emulate a specific device. Sets viewport, scale, user agent, and touch. Presets: iphone-14, iphone-14-pro, iphone-15-pro, iphone-15-pro-max, iphone-se, ipad, ipad-pro-11, ipad-pro-12.9, pixel-7, pixel-7-pro, galaxy-s23, galaxy-s23-ultra, galaxy-tab-s8, desktop-1080p, desktop-1440p.
tools.name: set_device

tools.description: Set values in extension storage via Runtime.evaluate in the extension's service worker. Area: local (default), sync, session, or managed.
tools.name: set_extension_storage

tools.description: Set extra HTTP headers that will be sent with every request
tools.name: set_extra_headers

tools.description: Override the browser geolocation. Latitude and longitude in decimal degrees.
tools.name: set_geolocation

tools.description: Enable or disable network offline emulation
tools.name: set_offline

tools.description: Set a value in localStorage or sessionStorage. Type must be "local" or "session".
tools.name: set_storage

tools.description: Set network and CPU throttling. Network presets: slow-3g, fast-3g, slow-4g, fast-4g, offline, none. Custom download/upload in bytes/sec override the preset. CPU rate is a slowdown multiplier (1=normal, 4=4x slower, max 20).
tools.name: set_throttling

tools.description: Override the browser user agent string
tools.name: set_user_agent

tools.description: Set the browser viewport size and device metrics. Width and height in pixels.
tools.name: set_viewport

tools.description: Capture a named DOM snapshot (simplified accessibility tree) for later comparison with dom_diff. Returns a summary of the captured tree.
tools.name: snapshot_dom

tools.description: Start collecting JavaScript code coverage for the current page
tools.name: start_coverage

tools.description: Start live network request logging for all current and new browser tabs. Captures URL, method, status, headers, and timing, including requests started by links that open a new tab. Use get_network_log to read entries.
tools.name: start_network_log

tools.description: Start Chrome tracing. Optional categories (comma-separated, e.g. "devtools.timeline,v8.execute"). Default captures timeline, network, and rendering events.
tools.name: start_trace

tools.description: Stop coverage collection and return final summary
tools.name: stop_coverage

tools.description: Stop Chrome tracing and save the trace file. Provide a path to write the trace JSON, or it writes to the output directory.
tools.name: stop_trace

tools.description: Switch execution context to a frame. Use "main" for the top frame, a frame name, a numeric index (from list_frames), or a CSS selector for the iframe element.
tools.name: switch_frame

tools.description: Switch to a browser tab by target ID
tools.name: switch_tab

tools.description: Type text into an element by CSS selector or @ref (e.g. @1 from page_snapshot). Timeout in seconds (default 30).
tools.name: type_text

tools.description: Uninstall a Chrome extension by ID. Tries CDP Extensions.uninstall, then chrome.management.uninstall() in the service worker, then disables via chrome.developerPrivate.
tools.name: uninstall_extension

tools.description: Upload file(s) to a file input element by CSS selector or @ref. Provide absolute file paths.
tools.name: upload_file

tools.description: Validate a cdpscript script without starting a browser or executing actions. Provide path or script; script may be txtar or plain .cdp.
tools.name: validate_script

tools.description: Wait for an element to be visible by CSS selector or @ref. Timeout in seconds (default 30).
tools.name: wait_for

tools.description: List recent tool invocations observed via the WebMCP domain. Shows tool name, input, status, output, and timing.
tools.name: web_tool_invocations
